title: Screening and identification of a new antimicrobial, Streptomyces rehmanniae, from the rhizosphere of Rehmannia glutinosa
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19412-19426
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07947K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hairong He, Tong Wang, Jiaqi Li, Chen Sun, Zhaoxu Ma, Zhenzhu Zhao, Xiaoke Zheng, Pengqiang Du
Strain Rer75 with strong antibacterial activity was identified as a novel species designated as “Streptomyces rehmanniae”. The strain produced a new compound that exerted antibacterial effects by targeting bacterial cell walls and cell membranes.
